description: Every statement launch material may make about the Design Studio, with the evidence that it is true. Public copy cites a claim as <!-- claim:id --> and may cite only a verified one. tests/launch-claims.unit.test.ts fails when a claim's evidence is gone, or copy cites an unknown or unverified claim.

claims.text: Clubs design match shirts, goalkeeper shirts, training tops, T-shirts, shorts, goalkeeper shorts and socks, in 2D, 2.5D and 3D.
A club's designs, rosters, collections, logos and requests are visible to that club alone, held by the database itself.

evidence.contains: a club reaches no design but its own: not the platform’s, not another club’s, by list or by id
row-level security: the database itself gives a club its own designs and revisions only, and accepts no write into another club’s

claims.text: Every save is a version kept as it was saved; any version can be restored as a new one.

evidence.contains: restores revision 1 as a new revision; every stored revision is unchanged

claims.text: A club keeps its colours and logos; logos are re-encoded on the server, never stored as uploaded.

evidence.contains: keeps a logo only as the PNG the server re-encoded: never the uploaded bytes

claims.text: Names, numbers and sizes for a whole squad, typed or imported from a spreadsheet, previewed on the garment.

evidence.contains: creates and opens a roster with the editor core’s checks, refusing what the core refuses and writing nothing for it

claims.text: A collection gathers a kit's designs and counts its sets per size for a roster.

evidence.contains: the order sheet: the roster’s sets per size for each design’s garment form, by the editor’s own rule

claims.text: Staff comment on a design; only a club administrator approves a version, and an approval is never changed.

evidence.contains: a club administrator alone decides, on the newest version only; a new version needs its own approval
decisions are never changed or removed, on the system path too; another club reaches none of it

claims.text: A collection prints, or saves as a PDF, as a presentation of the kit.

evidence.contains: in print only the sheet is laid out, on A4 landscape pages, as a real PDF

claims.text: The studio suggests colourways that keep every name, number and mark readable.

evidence.contains: suggests the same colourways in the same order every time, each legible, each pattern showing, each a valid design

claims.text: A club asks Familista for a quotation; Familista obtains quotations from suppliers it has verified and publishes them to the club; nothing is ordered until the club accepts one.

evidence.contains: quotations: a verified supplier’s only, with its reference and evidence; the club sees a published one and nothing of the record
of two racing acceptances one lands; the other quotation is superseded; nothing is charged

claims.text: After acceptance, the club follows its order through production, shipping and delivery.

evidence.contains: the Owner confirms the order (with a note), records production and shipping; the club confirms delivery; the history is whole and immutable

claims.text: The studio is in English, German, French, Spanish and Arabic (right to left).
The studio's panels are checked against WCAG 2.2 A/AA in English and Arabic.

evidence.contains: axe finds no WCAG 2.2 A/AA violation
axe finds no WCAG 2.2 A/AA violation

claims.text: Pay online.
claims.reason: M6: needs a payment provider, its keys, and the compliance and tax decisions. Nothing is charged today.

claims.text: Named partner factories.
claims.reason: No supplier agreement exists. Suppliers are records the Owner verifies; none is presented as a partner.

claims.text: Suppliers log in and quote directly.
claims.reason: The Supplier Portal is not approved; access stays owner-brokered.

claims.text: Individuals design their own kit.
claims.reason: M5: needs personal (club-less) accounts, an identity decision.

claims.text: Jackets, hoodies, tracksuits and polos.
claims.reason: M1c: deferred; shown as Planned in the studio.

claims.text: AI-generated designs.
claims.reason: Design assistance is deterministic; AI generation needs an approved provider and its terms.

claims.text: Colours on screen match the printed garment.
claims.reason: Screen colours are sRGB previews; the printed colour depends on fabric and process, settled by physical samples.
